name: Sugiuchi Kokoro
source:
A female student who works part-time at a maid cafe.
She has a quiet personality, but is straightforward and sociable.
She has a surprisingly curious nature and gets absorbed in things that interest her.
She has only been working for a short time and has made many mistakes due to her clumsiness.
She has a coquettish appearance with full breasts that are disproportionate to her innocent and cute face, which makes her very popular among the otaku customers.
